messages.subject: MSstats v3.3.9 is released
messages.body_plain:
Dear MSstats users,
MSstats v3.3.9 is released.

- Condition plot from dataProcessPlots : Now condition plots are drawn with run-level summarized intensities per condition.

- ComparisonResult from groupComparison
- flag about missingness and imputation : Calculation for MissingPercentage and ImputationPercentage columns is changed.
1) MissingPercentage : number of measured intensities/ total number of intensities (which is the number of features * the number of runs in a protein) in the conditions used for comparison (from ‘Label’ column) by protein. Therefore different comparisons(Label in the output) from the same protein can have the different percentage of missingness. For example, if you want to compare 'T7-T3', it will show the percentage of missing intensities in T3 and T7 among total intensities in T3 and T7.
2) ImputationPercentage : number of imputed intensities/total number of intensities in the conditions used for comparison (from ‘Label’ column) by protein. Therefore different comparisons(Label in the output) from the same protein can have the different percentage of imputation.

- new column, ‘issue’, shows special cases, such as completely missing in a condition or all conditions for comparisons.
                - if one of conditions that you want to compare is completely missing, 'oneConditionMissing' in 'issue' column and MSstats put zero value for 'adj.pvalue' and Inf or -Inf for 'logFC' column. Then it will be shown in volcano plot. (And '*' will be appeared on the left of protein name in volcano plot.)
               - if all conditions that you want to compare are completely missing, 'adj.pvalue' and 'logFC' column will be NA.

- VolcanoPlot
- flag the proteins which have the condition with completely missing. On the left of protein name, ‘*’ will be appeared in Volcano plot.

Please let us know if you have any difficulty.

- MSstats developers
